summary: User transferred over four hundred thousand USD in USDC to a Coinbase deposit address using the unsupported Hyperliquid L1 network which prevented the funds from being credited or recovered under exchange policy.
user_mistake: Sent USDC to a custodial exchange using an unsupported blockchain network
prevention: Confirm the exact supported network shown in the exchange deposit interface before initiating transfer / Match the sending network to the displayed supported network exactly
